title: Capacity constraint
summary: Not one knob: accelerators, HBM, power and electrical gear bind in turn
existingBody:
Anthropic doesn't say what "capacity-driven" means internally. Industry-wide, the
binding constraint has **moved**: power (2024–early 2025), then chips (late 2025 –
early 2026), then long-lead electrical gear (from ~May 2026).
relationships: corrects → Capacity is all about GPUs [m-gpu] (power, HBM and electrical gear each bind in turn)

title: Cost at a fixed capability
summary: The Epoch metric: the cheapest model that clears a benchmark bar, not a frozen model getting cheaper
existingBody:
The fixed thing is the **capability** (a benchmark score), not the model. The model that
clears a bar in 2026 is smaller and cheaper than the one that cleared it in 2025. A
frozen set of weights gets cheaper too, but through serving work and hardware, in
lumps, and far more slowly.
relationships: corrects → The 100×/year means a given Sonnet gets 100× cheaper [m-sonnet] (it's the cheapest model that clears a fixed bar)
